static_proof.mutation_testing: Thirteen defect classes, each reintroduced alone; ALL THIRTEEN detected; each source file restored and verified byte-identical by SHA-256. M9 is now detected on BOTH lane-start capture call sites via child-process execution of main(), which the previous bounce could not claim. M8 regressed during this bounce -- the nesting fix made its empty-body fixture non-empty, so it silently stopped exercising its own branch -- and was caught by the battery and repaired.

premise_verification.claim: The replaced codex dry-run test could not observe the packet layer.
premise_verification.method: Restored the replaced test verbatim from 581af41bf145f17dea8cfae4966c799f58077748, applied the M1 defect (dry run takes the capturing path), ran the suite.
premise_verification.result: The replaced test PASSED with the defect present, while both new mutation-sensitive tests FAILED.
premise_verification.why: It named an issue with no manifest on disk, so main() exited at the manifestExists guard; a 'no manifest found' refusal satisfies every one of its assertions.

isolation.mechanism: getRepoRoot() (scripts/ops/shared.ts:463) runs `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` with no cwd option, inheriting process.cwd(). Executing an entrypoint as a child process with cwd inside a git-initialised fixture directory rebinds ROOT to it for the whole run.
isolation.offline_mechanism: Stub codex/claude CLIs on PATH satisfy the health checks; the stub bin directory is kept outside the fixture git repository so it is not untracked content.
isolation.verified: docs/06_status/lanes and .ops/sync in the live checkout contain no UTV2-9999xx fixture after the full suite runs.

defect.root_cause: execution-packet.ts is reached only through two entrypoints whose main() functions were effectively untested. codex-exec.ts calls process.exit() at 19 sites and shells out to the real codex CLI for its health check, so an in-process test could neither survive it nor run it offline; the existing test avoided both by never getting far enough to matter.
defect.second_defect: The two claude dry-run tests did reach packet generation, but wrote their lane manifest and sync record into the live checkout at ROOT. An interrupted run leaves those behind, and the concurrency governor reads a stray manifest in docs/06_status/lanes as a real active lane.
defect.third_defect: The inherited control-character test asserted a property that held trivially for its own fixture.

previously_disclosed_risks_now_fixed: Linear is no longer a dependency of every lane start and resume; only a first capture needs it.
The resume path no longer merges a lane worktree write against the control checkout's record, so branch-accumulated entities are preserved.
safety_posture.residual: A first capture for a lane with no contract anywhere still requires a reachable Linear and a valid token. That is intended: there is no work order to proceed from.

known_limitations: The packet parser's heading whitelist still does not cover '## Deliverables' or '## Hard constraints', which UTV2-1736 uses. No content is lost and no field falsely claims 'none declared'; residue now preserves line structure. Widening the whitelist was explicitly out of scope for this lane.

Fixture helpers are duplicated across the two exec test files rather than shared: this lane may not add a file, and importing a helper from another test module would re-register that module's tests in both runs.

The fresh-lane path's post-capture persistence is asserted through the resume path; a fresh lane's own worktree creation runs an isolated pnpm install that a fixture cannot satisfy offline. The fresh capture call site itself is covered (M9b).

carry_forward_audit.scope: All eight script files from rejected PR #1445, compared by SHA-256 against current main, preserved head 581af41b, and this worktree.
carry_forward_audit.finding: lane-start.ts and lane-start.test.ts were accidentally omitted. They are the capture step: on main, lane-start writes a sync record with no task_contract, and readTaskContract throws 'task contract is absent' for every real lane.
carry_forward_audit.precision_correction: Capture is NOT absent altogether. The exec-time path (generateDispatchExecutionPacketResult) still captures and persists at dispatch. The omission specifically breaks the DRY-RUN path, which deliberately never captures - so without lane-start-time capture, every --dry-run on a real lane refuses. That is the exact path this lane's new tests exercise.
carry_forward_audit.clean_port_verified: main has not moved on either file since merge-base e4f32988, so the port applied with no reconciliation.
carry_forward_audit.tier_c_consequence: lane-start.ts matches the Tier C pattern ^scripts/ops/(lane|merge|tier)-[^/]+(?<!\.test)\.ts$, so this lane is now Tier C. Measured board state: the two existing hard fails (UTV2-1729<->UTV2-1743 Tier C conflict, and UTV2-1743 merged-but-in_review) predate this change and involve neither UTV2-1747 nor UTV2-1736. Tier C contention gates /dispatch admission, not PR merge.

end_to_end_proof_utv2_1736.method: Real read-only Linear fetch for UTV2-1736, then build, persist, re-read and render, all against an isolated root. The live UTV2-1736 lane was never written.
end_to_end_proof_utv2_1736.parser_limitation: UTV2-1736 uses '## Deliverables' and '## Hard constraints', which no whitelist consumes, so guardrails and acceptance_criteria are not cleanly extracted. Nothing is lost: content is carried verbatim in unmapped_sections and unextracted fields render as '(not extracted)' rather than '(none declared)'. Recorded as a follow-up; parser expansion is out of scope for this lane.

pm_bounce_1.finding_1_standalone_cli: FIXED. execution-packet main() routed through generateDispatchExecutionPacketResult (capture, persist, then the identical strict validator). Executing child-process CLI test with curl stubbed; M10 proves non-vacuity.
pm_bounce_1.finding_2_nested_acceptance: FIXED. parseSections is nesting-aware: a line belongs to the deepest heading and every ancestor, and consuming a parent consumes its descendants so residue is not duplicated. M11 proves non-vacuity.
pm_bounce_1.finding_3_residue_flattening: FIXED. join(' ') plus whitespace collapse replaced with line-preserving residue, and the renderer emits multiline bodies verbatim rather than folding them into a bullet. M12 proves non-vacuity. Measured on the real UTV2-1736 issue: the three safety constraints now render on their own lines.
pm_bounce_1.finding_4_threads_and_proof: Threads resolved and proof claims updated to match the final implementation.

contract_lifecycle.capture_failure_leaves_no_state: Measured on both paths: no lease, no sync record in either root, manifest byte-identical; on the fresh path no branch, worktree or manifest is created.
